messages:
Alex Chen: Quick heads up — I'm on a red-eye flight and will be offline from ~18:10 PT. Need someone to cover primary for the 18:00-02:00 UTC window. Pager flared earlier for eu-west-1 embeds but looks stable now. Adding context: last spike correlates with batch job rollout.
Maria Gomez: I can take primary starting 18:05 PT. I'll shadow for the first 20m and keep Samir as secondary unless he objects.
Samir Patel: OK to be secondary. I'll watch alerts and can step in if error rate > 3% or p99 latency > 800ms.
Alex Chen: Thanks — leaving runbook pointers: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall-coverage (see section "shift-swap-checklist"). Key steps: 1) confirm PagerDuty handoff, 2) validate telemetry for model-serving, 3) run quick health checks:
```
# quick health checks
curl -sS https://telemetry.redwood/api/health | jq .serving_status
redis-cli -h cache-main info | grep used_memory
# sanity: list running inference pods
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=redwood-serving
```
Priya Rao: @Maria, FYI there's a planned Dedicated capacity resize at 19:00 UTC in us-west that may briefly change routing. If you see fallback to the cheaper model, don't panic — that's expected. There's an autoscaler job that runs the preflight at 18:55 UTC.
Maria Gomez: Noted. I'll flag any unexpected model variant falls to the #incidents channel. Also adding to the handoff notes: prefix cache TTL for chat sessions has been lowered — might increase backend QPS.
OncallBot: Incident alert — 1729000910: embeddings-error-rate-euwest — RESOLVED. Summary: transient batch job collision increased queue depth; mitigation applied: canceled job + restarted worker pool. No customer-facing errors detected.
Samir Patel: Good to know. Maria — if you need a quick rollback of the job, use infra playbook 2 (link in runbook). It has the exact kubectl/helm rollback commands.
Maria Gomez: Copy that. I'll set a short bump monitor: check error-rate and queue-depth every 5m for the first hour. I'll post status updates here.
Alex Chen: Appreciate it. Also dropping a note: if on-call needs to escalate to SRE L2, ping @Priya and escalate via the SRE rotation channel. Use the template in runbook to capture the timeline for postmortem.
Priya Rao: I'll be reachable on mobile if anything gets weird. Also ensure to annotate traces with trace_id tag "handoff-1729001234" for correlation.
InfraBot: Deploybot scheduled resize for dedicated-pool-uswest at 2024-08-15T19:00:00Z — posting deploy plan: commit f3a2c9 -> resize replicas 12->16. No schema changes.
Maria Gomez: Starting handoff: primary changed to Maria Gomez at 18:05 PT. Secondary Samir Patel. Shadow until 18:25 PT. Monitoring: set alert window to 1m for error-rate and 5m for latency.
Samir Patel: Confirmed. PagerDuty status: Alex Chen acknowledged, escalation routing unchanged.
OncallBot: Reminder: please update the rotation doc https://internal.redwood/oncall/schedule after any swaps.
Maria Gomez: Updated schedule. Leaving the final note: if you see sustained p95 latency > 400ms in embeddings, set temporary routing to smaller batch size per the Optimize guide (command snippet in runbook). I'll post exact commands if triggered. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — on-call swap confirmed. I'll DM Maria the context notes from the last deploy.
Maria Gomez: All good. Will report back at 19:15 PT or sooner if anything pops. :eyes:
Samir Patel: I'll stay on standby. GLHF.
OncallBot: Thread closed by user action at 1729004720 (handoff acknowledged).
